description: This file is a Rebol script for extracting and processing requirements from XML files and source code, including functions for XML parsing, file searching, and command-line argument handling.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Returns the rightmost n characters of a string.

methods.name: find-files
methods.description: Recursively searches directories for files matching specified suffixes.

methods.name: req-xml
methods.description: Parses an XML file to extract requirement IDs based on filters.

methods.name: req-source
methods.description: Reads source files (.c and .h) from directories and extracts requirement annotations.
